endorsements.quote: Begin with a small-scale pilot project focusing on a single competency (eg, communication).
Incorporate artificial intelligence literacy into medical curricula.

Nevertheless, institutions should address faculty resistance by providing hands-on workshops, co-designing AI use cases with educators, and sharing evidence from pilot studies to build confidence in its implementation.

unlisted_practices: Provide prompt engineering training for faculty members.
Develop ethical guidelines for student use of generative AI.
Collaborate with technology experts to conduct longitudinal assessments of learner performance with generative AI.
Design simulated scenarios that support interprofessional education.
Maintain educator oversight of AI-automated essay grading.
Explore offline or low-bandwidth alternatives to ensure broader access to AI tools in underserved regions.
Protect learner performance data through strict data security measures such as closed systems and robust encryption.
Use bias auditing and mitigation frameworks such as Fairlearn and AI Fairness 360 to reduce bias in AI systems.
Use GPT-4o as a strategic supplement scaffolded into curriculum frameworks rather than as a replacement for existing teaching.
